ValidationRule.description: When the account credit status is selected as the 'OnHoldFinance' or 'Suspended' reason is mandatory
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( OR( ( $Profile.Id ='00e7F000000uSSj'), ($Profile.Id ='00e7F000000uSSi') ),
OR( ISPICKVAL( CreditStatus__c ,'On Hold - Finance'), ISPICKVAL( CreditStatus__c ,'Suspend'),ISPICKVAL(CreditStatus__c ,'On Hold - Compliance')) ,
ISBLANK(TEXT( Reasons_Picklist__c )) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select the reason when the credit status is On-Hold Finance,Suspend,On Hold - Compliance
